name: security-gcp-secretmanager-version-authority-review
intent: Secret Manager version access and conditional IAM scope
artifacts: Principal bindings/conditions, secret/version identifiers, workload consumer and owner revocation policy.
trace: Separate metadata, secret-version access and permission to change IAM/version state. Evaluate the actual resource/condition context used by the workload.
experiment: Use an owned secret with a synthetic value and compare intended principal/version with a restricted owned principal.
disproof: A secret name or version listing is not access to secret bytes; a missing version is not authorization evidence.
repair: Constrain access and delegation to intended secrets/versions and retest permitted rotation workflows.
branch_decisions: Resolve the full project/secret/version and any alias at access time. Metadata/list permissions and secret-version payload access differ. An alias such as latest can change during rotation; compare the authorized resource and actual selected version, including conditional IAM context, rather than assuming permission on one version generalizes to all secret data.
